verdict.rationale: Raygun offers some rule-driven background behavior: alert rules that automatically create PagerDuty incidents, Slack notifications, and conditional 'ignore by rule/time/occurrence' statuses. Its AI features are on-demand chat and suggestions, not autonomous background agents. missing for 10: user-configurable autonomous AI or agentic automations (e.g., auto-triage or auto-fix running unattended), a documented automation or workflow builder, scheduling of background tasks, and independent corroboration.
